faq.section_description: Quick answers to common setup, WhatsApp, and plan questions. For the full list, see General FAQ in Docs.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

supported_platforms.question: Which platforms does Akeed support?
supported_platforms.answer: Akeed supports Shopify directly through an app you install from the App Store. Independent stores can also use Akeed without any particular platform, by creating orders inside Akeed and sending confirmations on WhatsApp.

setup_time.question: How long does setup take?
setup_time.answer: Most merchants finish setup in a few minutes and can send a test confirmation right away.

own_whatsapp_number.question: Do I need my own WhatsApp number to start?
own_whatsapp_number.answer: No. Most merchants start with Akeed's shared official infrastructure, then move to their own number later if needed.

official_apis.question: Are messages sent through official WhatsApp APIs?
official_apis.answer: Yes. Akeed uses official Meta WhatsApp APIs for reliable message delivery.

customize_messages.question: Can I customize Akeed's messages and language?
customize_messages.answer: Yes. You can customize the confirmation copy and choose the language style that best fits your brand and customer base.

customer_no_reply.question: What happens if the customer does not reply?
customer_no_reply.answer: The order stays unconfirmed so your team can hold it, follow up, or skip shipping based on your process.

standalone_start.question: Can I start right away if my store is independent?
standalone_start.answer: Yes. Create an account and verify your email, and it is activated immediately with your launch credits, so you can create orders and send confirmations straight away. Shopify stores can start as soon as they install.

credit_usage.question: How exactly are credits counted?
credit_usage.answer: One credit is used per WhatsApp message sent to a customer, not per order. If you send a follow-up to a customer who hasn't replied, that uses a second credit. Messages the provider cannot deliver are refunded automatically.

legal.termsIntro: By using Akeed, you agree to the following terms and conditions.
legal.termsSection1Body: Akeed provides automated WhatsApp-based order verification for e-commerce stores operating with cash-on-delivery payment models.
legal.termsSection2Body: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account.
legal.termsSection3Body: We process order and customer data solely for the purpose of providing verification services. See our Privacy Policy for details.
legal.termsSection4Body: Akeed is provided on an "as-is" basis. We do not guarantee uninterrupted service and are not liable for indirect damages arising from use of the service.
legal.termsSection5Body: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
legal.privacyIntro: This policy explains how Akeed collects, uses, and protects your data.
legal.privacySection1Body: We collect account information (email, name, company), store data (orders, customer details for verification), and usage data (access logs, feature usage).
legal.privacySection2Body: Your data is used to provide order verification services, improve our platform, and communicate service updates. We do not sell your data to third parties.
legal.privacySection3Body: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. You may request deletion of your data at any time by contacting support.
legal.privacySection4Body: We use industry-standard encryption and security practices to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
legal.privacySection5Body: For privacy-related inquiries, contact us at support@getakeed.com.
legal.refundIntro: This policy explains how refunds, message credits, and subscription cancellations work on Akeed.
legal.refundSection1Body: Akeed sells prepaid WhatsApp order-verification message credits and offers a Shopify app subscription. Credits are consumed each time a verification message is sent.
legal.refundSection2Body: All message credit purchases are final and non-refundable once completed, regardless of whether the full balance is used. Purchased credits do not expire.
legal.refundSection3Body: The Akeed Shopify app subscription can be cancelled at any time from your Shopify admin billing page. Cancellation follows Shopify's own billing cycle rules and does not refund the current billing period.
legal.refundSection4Body: To cancel, uninstall the Akeed app from your Shopify admin or cancel the subscription from your Shopify billing settings. Any remaining message credit balance is retained on your account and remains usable if you reinstall.
legal.refundSection5Body: For billing disputes or exceptional refund requests, contact us at support@getakeed.com or +201148675077.

page.title: Import orders
page.subtitle: Upload a CSV or Excel file from your store, marketplace or spreadsheet. Akeed prepares the orders for WhatsApp confirmation, and nothing is sent until you start.

nothingSent.banner: Nothing has been sent to customers.
nothingSent.short: No message will be sent now.

orderImport.viewer: Only owners and admins can import orders. You can view this import but not change it.

upload.heading: Upload your file
upload.dropActive: Drop the file to upload it
upload.helper: CSV or Excel (.xlsx) · up to 5 MB · up to 5,000 orders
upload.templatePrompt: Don't have a file ready? Download template:
upload.templateFailed: The template could not be downloaded. Try again.

IMPORT_FILE_REQUIRED.title: No file was received
IMPORT_FILE_REQUIRED.body: Choose one CSV or Excel file and upload it again.

IMPORT_FILE_TOO_LARGE.title: This file is larger than 5 MB
IMPORT_FILE_TOO_LARGE.body: Remove extra columns or split the file into smaller parts, then upload again.

IMPORT_FILE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED.title: This file type isn't supported
IMPORT_FILE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED.body: Save it as Excel Workbook (.xlsx) or CSV UTF-8 and upload it again. Older .xls files and files with macros can't be read.

IMPORT_FILE_PROTECTED.title: This file is password-protected
IMPORT_FILE_PROTECTED.body: Remove the password in Excel (File → Info → Protect workbook) and upload it again.

IMPORT_FILE_UNREADABLE.title: This file couldn't be read
IMPORT_FILE_UNREADABLE.body: It may be damaged or not really a spreadsheet. Open it, save it again as .xlsx or CSV UTF-8, and upload it again.

IMPORT_FILE_EMPTY.title: This file has no orders
IMPORT_FILE_EMPTY.body: Add your orders under the header row and upload it again.

IMPORT_ROW_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.title: This file has too many orders
IMPORT_ROW_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.body: Split the file into parts of up to 5,000 orders and upload each part.

IMPORT_COLUMN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.title: This file has too many columns
IMPORT_COLUMN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.body: Keep up to 100 columns. Delete the columns you don't need and upload it again.

IMPORT_TOO_MANY_DRAFTS.title: You have too many unfinished imports
IMPORT_TOO_MANY_DRAFTS.body: Resume or discard one of the imports below before uploading another file.

IMPORT_RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many uploads in a short time
IMPORT_RATE_LIMITED.body: Wait a minute, then try again.

IMPORT_DISABLED.title: Importing orders isn't available
IMPORT_DISABLED.body: Importing orders from a file isn't turned on for your account yet.

IMPORT_ROLE_REQUIRED.title: Only owners and admins can import orders
IMPORT_ROLE_REQUIRED.body: Ask an owner or admin of your account to import this file.

IMPORT_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED.title: Importing isn't available for this store
IMPORT_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED.body: File import works only for Akeed stores that aren't connected to Shopify. Contact support if you think this is wrong.

IMPORT_SETUP_INCOMPLETE.title: Finish setting up your store first
IMPORT_SETUP_INCOMPLETE.body: Complete your store setup, then come back to import orders.

issues.PHONE_INVALID: This isn't a valid phone number.
issues.PHONE_NOT_MOBILE: This is a landline. WhatsApp needs a mobile number.
issues.PHONE_MULTIPLE: The cell has more than one phone number. Keep one.
issues.PHONE_SCIENTIFIC_NOTATION: Excel turned this phone into a number like 2.01E+11 and lost digits. Format the column as text and export again.
issues.NAME_TOO_LONG: Customer name is longer than 255 characters.
issues.AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE: Order amount must be more than zero.
issues.AMOUNT_AMBIGUOUS: We can't tell whether the comma separates decimals or thousands.
issues.AMOUNT_TOO_PRECISE: Order amount has more than 2 decimal places.
issues.PAYMENT_NOT_COD: Not cash on delivery, so it won't be confirmed.
issues.PAYMENT_UNKNOWN_EXCLUDED: No payment method, and your store doesn't treat a missing payment method as cash on delivery.
issues.ORDER_REF_TOO_LONG: Order number is longer than 100 characters.
issues.ORDER_REF_CONFLICT_IN_FILE: Another row has this order number with a different phone or amount.
issues.POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE: {match, select, order_number {Order {orderNumber} from {date} has the same order number.} other {Order {orderNumber} from {date} has the same phone and amount.}}
issues.ORDER_DATE_INVALID: We can't read this order date.
issues.ORDER_DATE_FUTURE: Order date is in the future.
issues.ORDER_TOO_OLD: Order is more than {maxAgeDays, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} old, too late to confirm.
issues.FIELD_TOO_LONG: A cell was longer than 1,000 characters and was cut short.
issues.CSV_MALFORMED_QUOTE: This row has a broken quote mark, so its cells may be shifted.
issues.unknown: This row has a problem Akeed can't describe yet.
